class.name: FoxHitArea3D
class.brief_description: Delivers a [Variant] payload to overlapping [FoxHurtArea3D] nodes.
class.description: Can act passively via physics overlaps, or instantly via the [method fire] method.

method.name: fire
method.description: Instantly delivers the payload to all [FoxHurtArea3D] nodes currently inside this area. Useful for immediate Area-of-Effect interactions like explosions.

members.member: The arbitrary data this hitbox will deliver upon intersection.

signal.name: hit_delivered
signal.description: Emitted when this hitbox successfully delivers its [param payload] to a [param target].
